units.source_text: 那样的念头虽说是突然产生，但是焚毁全阅这种想法，就犹如定做的西服穿起来特别会身。

en.t: Although that thought had come to me suddenly, the idea of burning it all down fit me as perfectly as a tailor-made suit.

units.source_text: 仿佛生下来就立志要这样做。

en.t: It was as though I had been born resolved to do exactly that.

units.source_text: 至少仿佛从与父亲相伴，初次邂逅金阁这天起就在我的体内孕育着等待开花。

en.t: At the very least, it seemed to have been growing inside me since the day I first encountered the Golden Pavilion with my father, waiting for the moment it would bloom.

units.source_text: 在少年的眼里，金阁是世上非同寻常的美，凭借这一点，我早已具备日后成为一名纵火者的种种理由了。

en.t: In the eyes of a boy, the Golden Pavilion was an extraordinary beauty unlike anything else in the world, and for that reason alone I already possessed all the grounds that would one day make me an arsonist.
